name: Discharge-coil capacitor-bank interface
summary: Identifies the documented discharge or measurement connection associated with the selected capacitor bank.
description: Identifies the documented discharge or measurement connection associated with the selected capacitor bank. High-voltage primary equipment carries, interrupts, measures or conditions the main power circuit. Its function, insulation arrangement and equipment boundaries need to be distinguished from the secondary signals used to control it.

In a switchyard equipment diagram, the primary reference identifies the electrical role of an installed component while the linked equipment schedule and manufacturer drawing supply its exact construction and dimensions. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Capacitor-bank terminals” at the input and “Assigned discharge-coil connection” at the output. The reference does not establish a safe discharge time.
